name: agent-kit-monorepo
description: Agent Kit monorepo: project intelligence layer for AI coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mapl6/agent-kit-core && npm run build -w @mapl6/agent-kit
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mapl6/agent-kit-core && npm run typecheck -w @mapl6/agent-kit && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm pack -w @mapl6/agent-kit-core --dry-run && npm pack -w @mapl6/agent-kit --dry-run
